author: Atdit
body:
I just thought about how many times I refresh the internet page (https://avicus.net/forums) to get an update, of all topics, replies etc.

My idea is: Add a refresh button 
or add an Auto refresh-function, so the forums will be automatically updated when a person replies to another one, or if new topics will be created, without manually refreshing the page.

Do you think it is needed? Probably not, but go ahead, and tell us your opinion!

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body:
I don't think some of you understand the concept of an auto-refresher. No, the page isn't going to refresh as if someone was holding down F5. What's going to happen is Ajax will make an asynchronous call to the server every second or so, only retrieving a small amount of data necessary for the server to determine if you have any alerts. If it returns true, or positive, your browser would then query the server for the new data. This would create a little bit of extra load on the server, but it won't crash the forums. Browser-based instant messaging works the same way. Also, if you're worried about this lagging the actual server, it won't. They're on two separate hosts.

@OP +1, I'd really like to see this be implemented.
